The decisive mistake was made by Verification_Expert at Step 1. It listed the Franklin-Foxboro line stops incorrectly. The list included stops that are not on the line, such as Back Bay and Ruggles in the wrong sequence relative to the true order, and Canton Center, Sharon and Mansfield placed before Windsor Gardens. It also put Windsor Gardens in the wrong position. The real order is South Station, Back Bay, Ruggles, Hyde Park, Readville, Endicott, Dedham Corporate Center, Islington, Norwood Depot, Norwood Central, and then Windsor Gardens. That gives 9 stops between them in the real order, and the expected answer is 10, so the stop list was wrong either way. The agent then ran code on its own wrong positions, which only confirmed the faulty count of 12.
